dedupe_keys.name: wqbc british columbia water quality thresholds

description: wqbc is an R package for applying water-quality thresholds and calculating indices in British Columbia. The provincial repository documents functions for assessing measurements against stated criteria. Users supply sample values, parameter names and locations; outputs include calculated water-quality scores or threshold comparisons for the selected observations. Geographic and regulatory coverage is British Columbia, although code may be adapted with other criteria. GitHub metadata states Apache-2.0 licensing for the package. A limitation is that a threshold index depends on the set of pollutants measured and does not represent transport or treatment processes. Current policy thresholds should also be checked against the relevant authority before a new study. wqbc can help validate water-quality consequences in drinking-water or watershed simulations. The related catalogue EPANET model simulates distribution hydraulics, not these quality-index calculations. No sample dataset or R package was downloaded.
